name: spreadsheet
description: Creates a new spreadsheet workbook and is the entry point to the fluent builder API. Passing "xlsx" (the default) or "xls" selects the workbook format; mutating methods on the returned workbook return the same object, so calls can be chained. Terminal reads such as getCellValue(), info() or toQuery() return data.

params.name: typeOrPath
params.description: Optional workbook type: "xlsx" (default) or "xls". Legacy .xls workbooks can be read but not written.

examples.title: Fluent builder
examples.description: Build a workbook with a query, a formatted header row and a frozen pane, then write it to disk.

examples.title: Plain workbook
examples.description: Create an empty workbook and use the Spreadsheet* function form on it.
